incident.short_description: Cannot connect to VPN - certificate error
incident.description: GlobalLink says 'The server certificate could not be validated / device certificate invalid'. Started this morning.

work_notes.body: Caller says the error started after laptop was off-network for 3 weeks (parental leave). Likely expired device cert.
